title: The Cod Wars
description: Between 1958 and 1976 Iceland and the United Kingdom clashed in three Cod Wars over fishing limits. The Royal Navy escorted British trawlers while the Icelandic Coast Guard cut their nets with long hawsers, and ships from both sides suffered damage from ramming. Iceland threatened to leave NATO. A 1976 NATO-brokered agreement ended more than 500 years of unrestricted British fishing in these waters. Source: Wikipedia, Cod Wars.
pinned_comment: Only one death is confirmed across all three Cod Wars: an Icelandic engineer in a 1973 accident. Did you know this one? 🐟 Tell me below 👇
